en.summary: North America drove improved adjusted earnings, while international and finance results were weaker. Share repurchases also affect per-share comparisons. The cash story requires particular care: adjusted automotive FCF has a different perimeter from consolidated OCF, and an annual guidance increase is not a fourth-quarter result already earned.
findings: Revenue was $50.015B, changing 2.931% YoY. GAAP diluted EPS was $3.73 versus $1.35 a year ago. These are realized standalone results for 2026-07-01–2026-09-30; changes in the business mix and special items need to be evaluated alongside the consolidated comparison.

GAAP operating income was $3.598B. Dividing it by revenue gives an operating margin of about 7.194%, versus 2.214% a year ago. Gross and operating margins measure different expense levels; neither measures cash left after capital investment or the return earned on the installed asset base.

Automotive OCF was $8.049B and adjusted automotive FCF $5.882B. The financial table separately contains consolidated OCF of $7.316B and cash PPE purchases of $2.346B. Subtracting the latter pair would give a different $4.970B consolidated calculation. The site preserves the company’s automotive measure rather than mixing its adjusted/perimeter result with consolidated cash inputs.

Adjusted EBIT increased to $4.106B from $3.376B, while North America contributed $3.592B versus $2.506B. International adjusted EBIT fell to $28M from $226M and GM Financial adjusted EBT fell to $668M from $804M. The improvement is therefore concentrated rather than uniform across geography and financing activities.

GAAP diluted EPS was $3.73 versus $1.35, while adjusted EPS was $3.70 versus $2.80. Outstanding shares fell to 849M from 904M at year-end 2025. EPS reflects earnings and the weighted-average diluted share count; the period-end count is useful capital-return context but is not the denominator used to recompute reported EPS.

Full-year adjusted EBIT guidance narrowed to $14.5B–$15.5B from $14B–$16B, while adjusted automotive FCF guidance increased to $11.5B–$12.5B from $9.5B–$11.5B. The new $20B repurchase authorization has no expiry and can be suspended. Neither the guidance nor the authorization represents cash already generated or shares already repurchased.

segments.name: GM North America
segments.text: Adjusted EBIT was $3.592B and adjusted margin 8.7%, versus $2.506B and 6.2% a year ago. This is the main operating improvement, but both figures are adjusted measures and should not be substituted for the group’s GAAP operating margin.

segments.name: GM International
segments.text: Adjusted EBIT was $28M versus $226M; China equity income was $32M versus $80M. Equity-method joint-venture income is not the same as consolidated regional revenue, so a geographic sales-growth conclusion cannot be inferred from these profit lines alone.

segments.name: GM Financial
segments.text: Adjusted EBT was $668M versus $804M. It measures financing activity on a pretax adjusted basis, distinct from automotive EBIT and automotive FCF. Credit performance, funding costs and lease residuals are relevant subsequent disclosures for assessing the lower result.

follow_ups.update: Compare actual repurchases, dividend cash and automotive FCF; keep authorization capacity separate.

limitations: Analysis uses the listed official filings, releases and financial attachments; official call text has not been fully reviewed.
Product/geographic categories, reportable segments and adjusted measures retain their disclosed perimeters and must not be double-counted or substituted for consolidated GAAP results.
Cash flows are standalone; cumulative disclosures are differenced across adjacent periods. Issuer adjustments, leases and incentives are identified in metric definitions.
No pre-release consensus snapshot was preserved. Management guidance and analytical inferences are distinct from realized results.

metrics.label: GAAP gross margin
metrics.definition: GAAP gross profit divided by quarterly revenue.
metrics.missing_reason: A comparable standalone quarterly value has not been verified.

metrics.label: Adjusted automotive free cash flow
metrics.definition: Company non-GAAP automotive perimeter and reconciliation; not consolidated free cash flow.
